text: 外交部发言人宣布：中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅将作为习近平主席特别代表出席10月15日在阿塞拜疆巴库召开的亚洲相互协作与信任措施会议第七次峰会，并于10月14日至20日访问阿塞拜疆、克罗地亚、黑山、保加利亚。(外交部网站)
text_en: Foreign Ministry spokesperson announced: Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister Wang Yi will attend the Seventh Summit of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence Building Measures in Asia in Baku, Azerbaijan on October 15 as President Xi Jinping's special representative, and will visit Azerbaijan, Croatia, Montenegro, and Bulgaria from October 14 to 20. (Foreign Ministry website)
